correctness.rationale: Every vertex weight is linear separately in each tree-edge parameter; the 5-vertex determinant sum has degree at most five in each. Tree-gauge cube reflections independently reverse each edge parameter, so the polynomial is even and has degree at most two in its square. Integer-determinant enumeration of all 4368 5-sets and all 16 trees at the 27 nodes (0,1,2)^3 verifies the proposed polynomial; distinct squared nodes (0,1,4) prove identity by tensor Lagrange interpolation. Sum and facet marginals are respectively 16 and 8 by forest parity cancellation. Explicit derivative calculation proves strict decrease in each squared correlation. The bundled checker was independently executed successfully.

value.rationale: Motivated by the original first-open four-cube inequality: the theorem treats all positive three-correlation connected tree Ising vertex weights, not a renamed disconnected two-correlation case. A single exact polynomial across all 16 labelled spanning trees establishes previously nonobvious topology independence between star and path families. Its sharp monotonic rigidity quantifies how every individual edge dependence reduces the conjectural normalized ratio, a structural result of independent interest within a genuine nontrivial family.
